posts.title: Ask W3C i18n
posts.description: Today we’re launching Ask i18n , an experimental tool from the W3C Internationalization Working Group. Internationalization helps make the Web work for people across languages, scripts, and cultures. With Ask i18n, we’re exploring a new way to support that work. This is an early experiment, and your feedback is welcome. We invite you to try it and share what works, what doesn’t, and what would make it more useful.

posts.title: FOR REVIEW: How can I use language metadata in native APIs?
posts.description: The article How can I use language metadata in native APIs? is out for wide review. We are looking for comments by Friday 18 December, 2026 . This article contains pointers to native APIs for applying language metadata to strings and text ranges. Please send any comments as GitHub issues by clicking on this link , or on “Leave a comment” at the bottom of the article. (That will add some useful information to your comment.)
